title: Strong desire through a changing rhythm

captions.physics: Arrange and carry out shared tasks

meaning: Your union can act in an organised way while a strong attachment to what you want intensifies through emotional turns.
text: Your shared life may be composed in action and changeable in feeling. In the physical position, the Emperor organises: defining tasks, deciding and following through. In energy, the Devil shows desire becoming binding and making refusal difficult. In emotions, the Wheel of Fortune conveys responses to changing circumstances. A welcome turn lifts the mood; a delay changes how the entire undertaking feels. Your overall tone narrows if organisation serves attachment and every emotional lift is treated as proof that the desired outcome must be obtained regardless of other considerations. Efficient action alone cannot settle that question.

For example, you spend a long time seeking a particular household item. A notification about a suitable listing enlivens the evening, while a vanished offer brings frustration. Searching and calling are efficiently divided, but you rarely ask whether you still need the object. **An organised search does not automatically make a strong desire free.** You can discuss the aim again even after fortunate coincidences create a welcome sense that the result is close, almost promising a resolution.

The difficulty appears if each mood turn changes the scale of commitment. A promising offer urges speed; a disappointment urges greater persistence. Trying to recover pleasure, you surrender more shared time to it. Order intensifies attachment rather than supporting choice. You can stop searching without first proving that the perfect moment to refuse has arrived or a definitive replacement exists.
